fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (37.736379,-97.325459) were ~well-placed at the plant; geocode noted movedMeters 2004 but landed on the correct complex. Confirmed by Street View 'DOLD' building signage. Locked center ~37.7352,-97.3256, address 2929 N Ohio St, Wichita KS 67219.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed via Street View (captured 2026-02): fenced perimeter with sliding gates across the truck driveway off N Ohio St on the south end of the plant. Truck Entrance/Exit signage present.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth structure sits on an island in the entrance driveway, splitting inbound and outbound truck lanes - visible in multiple Street View frames. Classic gate + guard-shack configuration.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Multiple dock faces with trailers backed in: a west-facing dock (~5-6 trailers seen), a north-segment dock (~5-6), plus additional dock banks. Total estimated 25-50 band (~32). Roof imagery partly overexposed - estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on the west and north building faces suggest separate shipping/receiving - inferred.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two trailer drop-yard clusters along the west side of the plant (between the building and the rail/canal), ~18-20 marked trailer stalls total.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron with an island booth and lanes on both sides; ample paved width to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs N-S in the floodway corridor immediately west of the plant but no spur crosses the grass buffer into the property. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within a dense industrial district of north Wichita, a major metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Plant complex includes the main processing building plus connected secondary buildings (a south warehouse and a north office block) - treated as a campus.

citations.claim: Hormel locations page: Dold Foods, Wichita KS, joined Hormel 1984, ~760+ employees, bacon production.
UFCW Local 2 union election at Dold Foods Wichita certified May 2025 confirms active workforce.

verification.rationale: Hormel-owned (since 1984) on its own locator at 2929 N Ohio St; 2025 NLRB election proves active operation; no closure/sale.
